questions.prompt: How do you view all configuration for an instance?
questions.explanation: lxc config show <name> displays all configuration options for an instance.

questions.prompt: How do you set limits.cpu to 2 for an instance named 'first'?
questions.explanation: lxc config set <name> <key>=<value> sets a configuration option.

questions.prompt: What does lxc config unset do?
options: Removes a config key and reverts to default
questions.answer: Removes a config key and reverts to default
questions.explanation: lxc config unset <name> <key> removes a configuration key, reverting it to its default value.

questions.prompt: What happens if you don't set limits.cpu on a container?
options: The container gets 1 CPU by default
The container sees all host CPUs
The container gets no CPU access
questions.answer: The container sees all host CPUs
questions.explanation: By default, containers inherit all host resources. Without limits, nproc inside a container shows the host's CPU count.
